name: PhotoCraft Go-Cam 4
description: Capture all of life's adventures with the PhotoCraft Go-Cam 4, the action camera that makes recording high-quality footage simple and affordable. The Go-Cam 4 records crisp 4K video at 30fps and takes vibrant 12MP photos, ensuring your memories are preserved in stunning detail. Its durable housing is waterproof down to 30 meters (100 feet), so you can take it from the mountains to the sea without a second thought. The advanced HyperSmooth 2.0 electronic image stabilization provides remarkably steady footage, even during bumpy bike rides or ski runs. A front-facing LCD screen makes framing selfies and vlogs effortless, while the intuitive rear touchscreen allows for easy control and playback. This camera is designed for adventurers, families, and casual users who want a reliable, easy-to-use action camera without a premium price tag. The Go-Cam 4 proves that you don't need to be a professional to capture professional-looking action shots. Features: 4K Video at 30fps and 12MP Photos, Waterproof to 30m (100ft) with included housing, HyperSmooth 2.0 Electronic Image Stabilization, Dual LCD Screens (Front and Rear), Time-lapse and Slow-Motion Modes. Advantages: Great value for the price; Effective image stabilization; Includes a wide array of mounting accessories. Considerations: Low-light performance is average; Audio quality from the internal mic is basic. Best for: Beginners, casual users, and budget-conscious adventurers looking for a capable action camera.
